description.zh:
应用ID，仅支持传单个ID。

默认查询所有应用ID。
description.en:
The application ID. You can specify only one ID.

By default, all application IDs are queried.

description.zh:
查询数据结束时间，UTC格式，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间。
description.en:
The end time of the queried data. The time is displayed in UTC. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.

The end time must be later than the start time.

The time granularity at which the data is queried. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: **3600** (one hour) or **86400** (one day). Default value: **3600**.
The service area. CN: China (default value).

description.zh: 查询数据起始时间，UTC格式，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
description.en: The start time of the queried data. The time is displayed in UTC. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.

title.en: Queries the number of active users of an application

descriptions.zh: > 数据查询的起止时间跨度最大为30天。
descriptions.en: > The maximum time span between the start time and the end time of a data query is 30 days.
